section: spec 5a — "the manifest work-unit table, and its column set: id, type, executor, depends-on, status"
question: 5a names `depends-on` as part of the work-item mental model and `/runs/[run-id]`'s work-unit table cannot render it: `i1`'s `RunWorkUnit` projection joins no `work_item_dependency` and selects neither `blocker_id` nor `external_wait_id`, so four of 5a's five columns are present and the fifth has no data behind it — should `RunWorkUnit` carry the dependency edge (or the two holding ids, as `/work-items` does), or is a run's work-unit table exempt from that column?
best_guess: Ship the four columns 5a names that the projection supports (unit, type, executor, status) plus the requirement-driven ones (disposition, evidence, not-verified, dates), and omit `depends-on` rather than inventing a substitute. Every row links to `/work-items/[id]`, where the edge is one click away and rendered as `blocked by` from a listing that does carry those ids. Widening i1's projection is another unit's file and D6 puts schema work out of scope, so this is named rather than filled.

section: CR-005 §3.2 FR-93 — component reuse across route boundaries
question: `/runs/[run-id]`'s work-unit table imports five chips from `@/app/work-items/_components/chips` — the first cross-route component import in this repository — because the alternative is a second copy of the seven-rung `STATUS_CLASS` ladder and the four-scope `EVIDENCE_STATE` table, and a state scale duplicated per screen stops being a scale; should those chips be hoisted to `@/components/` the way B33 hoisted `ProseValue` out of three detail views, and if so is that a B-fix after this milestone or in it?
best_guess: Import across the boundary rather than duplicate, and name it. Hoisting would mean editing `work-items/_components/chips.tsx` plus its five call sites inside a route this unit does not own, on an additive two-screen milestone — the reversible half is the import, and if Erik prefers the hoist it costs one line at this call site later. Typecheck, lint, build and `gate:m27` are all green with the import in place.
